aviation_incidents.headline: 法國航空AF28起飛後偏離離場程序接近美國航空AA1660 初步飛行追蹤資料顯示垂直間隔一度約400呎
aviation_incidents.summary: 11月7日約08:15 UTC，法國航空AF28（A350-900）自洛杉磯起飛後未依獲准的SUMMR2標準儀器離場程序左轉，接近約一分鐘後起飛的美國航空AA1660（A321-200）；初步追蹤資料顯示兩機垂直間隔一度約400呎。航管指示AA1660維持2,000呎，要求AF28轉向並向AA1660發出交通警示；兩機其後續飛目的地，無人受傷或飛機受損。截至11月8日，官方調查結果尚未公布，偏離原因仍未確認。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Air France AF28 deviates after takeoff, nearing American AA1660 as initial tracking shows about 400 ft vertical separation
aviation_incidents.summary_en: At about 08:15 UTC on November 7, Air France AF28 (A350-900) turned left off its cleared SUMMR2 departure after leaving Los Angeles, approaching American Airlines AA1660 (A321-200), which took off about a minute later. Initial tracking information put their vertical separation at about 400 feet. Controllers told AA1660 to maintain 2,000 feet, directed AF28 to turn and issued a traffic alert; both continued to their destinations with no injuries or aircraft damage. As of November 8, no official investigation findings or confirmed explanation had been released.

aviation_incidents.headline: 英國航空BA252波音777-200ER一度超出適用操作速限約7至10節 爬升後平安抵達倫敦希斯洛
aviation_incidents.summary: 上週北大西洋強勁噴射氣流期間，多班跨大西洋航班傳出超速示警；英國航空BA252波音777-200ER在3萬8千呎巡航時，一度超出適用操作速限約7至10節。機組先後爬升至3萬9千及4萬1千呎後，航班平安降落倫敦希斯洛，無人受傷或航機結構受損；噴射氣流與此次超速的確切關聯尚未確立。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: British Airways BA252 777-200ER briefly exceeds its operating limit by 7-10 knots, then lands safely at London Heathrow after climbing
aviation_incidents.summary_en: Several transatlantic flights reportedly received overspeed alerts during strong North Atlantic jet-stream conditions last week. British Airways BA252, a Boeing 777-200ER, was cruising at 38,000 feet when it briefly exceeded the applicable operating limit by about 7-10 knots. The crew climbed first to 39,000 feet and then to 41,000 feet; the flight landed safely at Heathrow with no injuries or structural damage. The precise connection between the jet stream and the overspeed has not been established.

international_aviation.headline: 伊拉克總理下令取消摩蘇爾機場三項租約 稱業者疑與武裝團體有關並擬邀國際業者參與營運
international_aviation.summary: 伊拉克總理11月7日下令取消摩蘇爾國際機場三項租約，涉及七座報到櫃台、停車場及計程車辦公室；當局稱業者疑與武裝團體有關，但未指明團體或公開證據。政府擬邀國際業者參與營運與共同管理，接替業者及時程尚未公布。
international_aviation.headline_en: Iraq's prime minister orders three Mosul Airport leases cancelled over alleged armed-group links and plans to involve international operators
international_aviation.summary_en: On November 7, Iraq's prime minister ordered the cancellation of three leases at Mosul International Airport, covering seven check-in counters, a car park and a taxi office. Authorities said the operators were suspected of links to armed groups but did not identify any group or publish evidence. The government plans to involve international companies in operating and jointly managing the airport; no replacement operators or timetable have been announced.

international_aviation.headline: 美國航空拒絕兌現地勤據稱承諾的650美元補償 稱航班改用較小機型使旅客不符法定非自願拒絕登機賠償資格 旅客最終僅獲442美元飛行抵用金
international_aviation.summary: 尼科爾·阿恰里表示，她遭美國航空拒絕登機後，地勤曾承諾提供650美元支票，或報銷租車、機票或飯店費用。美國航空稱航班改用較小機型，使她不符合聯邦非自願拒絕登機賠償資格，並稱650美元可能是提供給自願讓位旅客的方案。她先獲250美元飛行抵用金，消費者權益倡議者克里斯多福·艾略特介入後再獲192美元，合計442美元；地勤是否有權保證650美元仍未證實。
international_aviation.headline_en: American Airlines declines a gate agent's reported $650 promise, citing smaller-aircraft rules, while the passenger ultimately receives $442 in credits
international_aviation.summary_en: Nicholle Acciarri said she was denied boarding on an American Airlines flight from New York to Cleveland and that a gate agent promised a $650 check or reimbursement for a rental car, airline ticket or hotel. American said the aircraft had been changed to a smaller model, making her ineligible for federal involuntary denied-boarding compensation; it suggested the $650 amount may have been intended for passengers volunteering to give up their seats. She first received a $250 flight credit and another $192 after consumer advocate Christopher Elliott intervened, for a total of $442. Whether the gate agent had authority to guarantee $650 has not been established.
